reviewNotes: HOLD. LINEMO Best Plan remains JPY990/month through 3GB, with a current JPY3,850 contract administration fee. Foreign applicants require a residence card (plus foreign passport when not a permanent resident) and matching Japanese address details. Overseas SMS reception is free after World Support enrollment, but new-number contracts cannot enroll until the fifth billing month. Preserve as resident-only/conditional overseas knowledge, not a nonresident acquisition route.

events.outcome: Current LINEMO pricing, resident-foreigner identity requirements, contract fee and overseas SMS mechanics are documented; new-number lines cannot enroll in World Support until the fifth billing month.

data.acquisitionSummary: LINEMO Best Plan is SoftBank’s online-only subscription, currently JPY990/month through 3GB. Current application identity rules for foreign nationals require a valid residence card; non-permanent residents also provide a foreign passport, and the application name/address/date-of-birth must match current residence information.

keep.action: Maintain LINEMO Best Plan at the lowest usage tier, JPY990/month through 3GB. No idle PAYG number-retention mode is documented.

data.chinaActivation: A new nonresident signup from mainland China is not supported by the current residence-card/address identity path. For an existing qualifying line, China is in LINEMO’s international-roaming region, but a line opened with a new phone number cannot enroll in World Support until the fifth billing month.
data.kyc: Current foreign-national application requires a valid residence card; customers who are not permanent residents also need a foreign passport. Identity/address details must match the application. This is a Japanese-resident KYC route rather than passport-only tourist onboarding.
data.payment: Credit card or bank transfer. Current card support includes Visa, Mastercard, JCB, American Express and Diners Club; the card must be in the subscriber’s name and card registration uses 3D Secure 2.0. Foreign-issued-card reliability is not established.
data.roamingSms: With World Support enabled, LINEMO supports overseas SMS; receiving is free and sending is JPY100 per message. China is listed in the supported Asia roaming area. New-number contracts cannot enroll in World Support until the fifth billing month, so immediate overseas OTP use after a new signup is not available.
data.holdReason: The JPY990/month plan is current and overseas SMS is documented, but new acquisition requires Japanese resident identity/address information. A new-number contract also has a World Support enrollment wait until the fifth billing month, making this a poor nonresident/quick-overseas OTP route.
data.tariffSummary: LINEMO Best Plan is JPY990/month through 3GB plus a current JPY3,850 contract administration fee; foreign applicants use residence-card based KYC, and new-number lines face a roaming-option wait.
guideSteps: Budget JPY3,850 current contract administration plus JPY990/month at the lowest Best Plan tier.
Do not present LINEMO as a passport-only/nonresident signup route.
For a new-number line, account for the World Support eligibility delay before relying on overseas SMS.
